newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Shi'ite Moslem activist shot in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Shi'ite Moslem activist shot in Pakistan.

text.p: Gunmen wounded a Shi'ite Moslem activist in the Pakistani town of Khanewal on Monday in what his colleagues said was a sectarian attack.
They said two gunmen on a motorcyle shot Syed Zaheerul Hassan Rizvi, an industrialist and a local leader of the Shi'ite Tehrik-i-Jafria organisation, outside his home.
Doctors said Rizvi had been hit by nine bullets, including one in the neck, and was in critical condition.
Militant groups among Pakistan's Sunni Moslem majority and Shi'ite minority are locked in a long-running feud that has cost more than 40 lives so far this year.
